label: Scope of "no absolute truth"
term: scope of "no absolute truth" (global or local)
resolution: The global thesis has every content, its own formulation included, in scope; the local thesis restricts it to a demarcated domain. STMT-LOCAL-RELATIVISM-SECOND-ORDER asks where the local thesis itself falls: inside, it inherits the relative horn; outside and absolutely true, it is a concession that defeats only the global thesis. Exemption of the thesis from its own scope is a third option whose cost is STMT-EXEMPTION-REGRESS. These senses are distinct from the pilot's profile-variation senses (DISAMB-PILOT-RELATIVITY), which are not identified with them.
